scope: All 33 access-filter-retained publications from ranks 51-100. The seventeen access-excluded additions were not classified for this combined-retained breakdown.
coder: Assistant manual review; no external model API and no independent human validation.
reading_scope: Thirty-three public About-page openings and selected passages in two saved public posts per retained publication; additional full-text readings logged for ambiguous cases. The six-publication close review adds source-linked saved-post evidence for four additions and two original publications. Selection is purposive, not a representative article sample. Full-versus-passage scopes are listed per source.
rule: Affirmative policy positions, explicit self-description and repeated normative framing; nonpartisan news style, party support and anti-Trump positions are not automatic centrist or liberal labels.

rows.coalition: Democratic strategist; explicit party-building mission
rows.rationale: Explicit Democratic-strategist identity and advocacy for working people, protecting social insurance and confronting concentrated wealth support a liberal/center-left orientation; party loyalty is recorded separately.
